description.value: Prototype Coffee is a specialty microroastery and tasting room in Vancouver's Strathcona neighbourhood, roasting highly traceable single-origin coffees on small Aillio Bullet roasters right behind the counter. They offer over 15 different coffees on their brew bar at any given time, along with espresso drinks and seasonal creations. A second tasting room operates at 222 W 5th Ave in Mount Pleasant.

address.value: 883 East Hastings Street, Vancouver, BC, V6A 1R8
